title: How frogQuiz works
description: Twelve questions on making, hosting and joining a game in frogQuiz: who needs an account, what a draft is, how scoring works and what the host can do.

questions.question: What do players need to join a game?

answers.answer: A team account and a nickname
A game PIN and a nickname
A game PIN and a team account
The host's email address

questions.question: By default, what do players see on their phones during a question?

answers.answer: The full question with every answer's text
A text box where they type an answer
Coloured shapes that match the big screen
Only a countdown timer

questions.question: Which of these work for signing in with your work email? Pick every correct answer.

answers.answer: The link in the email we send
A password you chose at sign-up
The six-digit code in the same email
A QR code on the sign-in page

questions.question: Which email addresses can sign in to frogQuiz?

answers.answer: Any personal address, such as Gmail or Outlook
Any work address from any company
Only addresses ending in @frog.co
@frog.co and @capgemini.com addresses

questions.question: What must a question have before the quiz can be played? Pick every correct answer.

answers.answer: A picture
Some question text
At least two answers
One answer marked as correct

questions.question: A quiz has one unfinished question. What happens when you try to host it?

answers.answer: The game will not start until it is finished
The unfinished question is skipped during play
Players see a blank question on their phones
The whole quiz is deleted after a few days

questions.question: What is the difference between a Public and an Unlisted quiz?

answers.answer: There is no difference
Unlisted quizzes are deleted after a day
Public shows in Discover, Unlisted needs the link
Public quizzes can be edited by anyone on the team

questions.question: To host a live game for the room, which button do you press on a quiz?

answers.answer: Edit
Download
Play
Practice

questions.question: Which of these can the host do in the lobby, before the first question? Pick every correct answer.

answers.answer: Start the game
Show the results
Lock the game so nobody new can join
Cancel the game

questions.question: A game has already started. Can a new player still join?

answers.answer: No, nobody can join once the game has started
Yes, unless the host has locked the game
Yes, but only with a team account
Only during the first question

questions.question: Two players both answer correctly on a 20-second question. One takes 2 seconds, the other takes 15. Who scores more?

answers.answer: The player who took 2 seconds
The player who took 15 seconds
They score the same
The player who joined the game first

questions.question: On a question with several correct answers, when does a player score points?

answers.answer: When they pick at least one of the correct answers
When they pick more than half of the options
They get a share of the points for each correct pick
Only if every correct answer is picked, and no others
